tools.name: telegram-inline-query
tools.description: Query an inline bot (like @gif, @bing) in a chat context and return the compact result list. Returns queryId, cacheTime, and results[{id,type,title?,description?,url?}]. The queryId is typically valid for ~60s and can be passed to telegram-inline-query-send to deliver a chosen result. Bot must be a real bot account

bot.description: Inline bot username (e.g. @gif) or numeric user ID

chatId.description: Chat ID or username providing context for the inline query

query.description: Query text the bot should resolve (may be empty string)

offset.description: Pagination offset returned by a previous call as nextOffset (empty string on first call)

tools.name: telegram-inline-query-send
tools.description: Send an inline bot result to a chat by queryId + resultId (as returned by telegram-inline-query). The queryId expires about 60s after the original query. Returns the sent messageId (0 if not extractable from the update).

chatId.description: Target chat ID or username to send the result into

queryId.description: queryId from a prior telegram-inline-query call (valid ~60s)

resultId.description: id of the chosen result from telegram-inline-query results[]

hideVia.description: Hide the 'via @bot' label on the sent message

clearDraft.description: Clear the chat draft after sending

tools.name: telegram-get-message-buttons
tools.description: List the inline/reply keyboard buttons on a Telegram message with their (row, col) indices, type (e.g. KeyboardButtonCallback, KeyboardButtonUrl), label and type-specific fields (callback data as base64, url, switchQuery, userId, copyText, etc). Helper for telegram-press-button — call this first to discover indices and filter by type before pressing. Returns markupType='none' and empty buttons when the message has no keyboard

chatId.description: Chat ID or username where the message lives

messageId.description: Message ID whose keyboard to inspect

tools.name: telegram-press-button
tools.description: Press an inline keyboard callback button on a message. Identify the button by (row, column) from its replyMarkup, or pass raw callback_data as base64. URL, switch-inline, game and 2FA-password buttons are rejected with a clear error. Returns the bot's callback answer: {alert?, hasUrl?, nativeUi?, message?, url?, cacheTime}

chatId.description: Chat ID or username where the message lives

messageId.description: Message ID whose inline button to press

row.description: Button row index (0-based) — required unless data is provided

column.description: Button column index (0-based) — required unless data is provided

data.description: Raw callback_data as base64 string (escape hatch — prefer row/column)

tools.name: telegram-get-state
tools.description: Initialize the polling cursor by fetching the current Telegram updates state {pts, qts, date, seq, unreadCount}. The returned {pts, qts, date} is the starting cursor for telegram-get-updates. The server does not store the cursor between calls.

tools.name: telegram-get-updates
tools.description: Fetch new messages, deleted messages, and other updates since a previously-known {pts, qts, date} cursor (from telegram-get-state or a prior call). Returns compact newMessages[], deletedMessageIds[], otherUpdates[] (className only), and the new cursor state. isFinal=false means more updates are queued — call again with the returned state. If Telegram reports the gap is too long, the result says so and the history has to be re-read per chat. The server does not store the cursor; each call takes the {pts, qts, date} returned by the previous one.

pts.description: Last known pts (from telegram-get-state or prior telegram-get-updates)

qts.description: Last known qts (secret-chat / encrypted stream cursor; 0 if unknown)

date.description: Last known date (unix seconds from prior state)

ptsLimit.description: Max updates per batch (default 100, capped at 1000)

ptsTotalLimit.description: Max total updates across paginated slices (default 1000, capped at 1000)

tools.name: telegram-get-channel-updates
tools.description: Fetch new messages and updates for a single channel/supergroup since a known per-channel pts cursor. Separate from the global cursor used by telegram-get-updates. Returns compact newMessages[], otherUpdates[], and new {pts, isFinal, timeout?}. If the channel gap is too long, Telegram returns a dialog snapshot instead, and this tool forwards it. The server does not store the cursor; each call takes the pts returned by the previous one.

chatId.description: Channel or supergroup ID or username

force.description: Force request updates even if the client hasn't processed previous ones (rarely needed)

tools.name: telegram-get-discussion-message
tools.description: For a channel post with comments enabled, returns the linked discussion-group info: discussionGroupId, discussionMsgId, unreadCount, readInboxMaxId, readOutboxMaxId, topMessage. Use discussionGroupId + discussionMsgId with telegram-send-message (replyTo=discussionMsgId) to post a comment.

chatId.description: Channel ID or @username that contains the post

messageId.description: ID of the channel post to get discussion info for

tools.name: telegram-send-venue

tools.name: telegram-send-album

Uploads are serial per item: expect ≈4-10s for 10 mid-size photos, 15-40s for 10 large videos. Prefer ≤5 items or photos when low latency matters.

caption.description: Per-item caption (shown under this item when the album is expanded)

tools.name: telegram-get-invite-links
tools.description: Get list of invite links for a group or channel. By default returns links created by the current account; pass adminId to query another admin's links

adminId.description: Admin user ID or username to list links for (default: current account)

tools.name: telegram-save-draft
tools.description: Save or clear a message draft for a chat. Pass empty text to clear the draft. Optional replyTo sets the message being replied to

text.description: Draft text. Empty string clears the draft

replyTo.description: Message ID this draft replies to

tools.name: telegram-get-drafts
tools.description: Get all saved message drafts across chats

tools.name: telegram-clear-drafts
tools.description: Delete saved message drafts. Pass chatId to clear the draft for a single chat. Without chatId, clears drafts in ALL chats — requires confirmAllChats: true

chatId.description: Chat ID or username. If provided, clears draft only for this chat

confirmAllChats.description: Must be true to wipe drafts across ALL chats when chatId is omitted

tools.name: telegram-get-saved-dialogs
tools.description: Get Saved Messages dialogs (Telegram's per-sender grouping of messages forwarded to your Saved Messages)

tools.name: telegram-revoke-invite-link
tools.description: Revoke an invite link for a group or channel

tools.name: telegram-set-emoji-status
tools.description: Set your profile emoji status (custom animated emoji shown next to your name). Requires Telegram Premium. Pass documentId or collectibleId to set — omit both to clear the status. Available IDs are listed by telegram-list-emoji-statuses.

documentId.description: Custom emoji document ID (stringified long). Omit to clear the status.

collectibleId.description: Collectible emoji ID (stringified long) — for paid unique emoji. Exactly one of documentId/collectibleId may be set.

untilUnix.description: Unix timestamp when status expires. Omit for permanent.

tools.name: telegram-list-emoji-statuses
tools.description: List default or recently-used emoji statuses available for your account. Useful for finding a documentId to pass to telegram-set-emoji-status.

kind.description: Which list: default (popular set), recent (your recent usage), channel_default (for channels), collectible (paid unique)

tools.name: telegram-clear-recent-emoji-statuses
tools.description: Clear your recently-used emoji status list (the 'recent' section in the emoji status picker).

tools.name: telegram-set-profile-color
tools.description: Set your profile name color or profile background color. Requires Telegram Premium for colors above index 6 and for profile background patterns. Omit color to reset to default.

forProfile.description: true = profile page color + background pattern (Premium); false = name color in chat lists

color.description: Color index (0-6 free palette; 7+ Premium custom). Omit to reset to default.

backgroundEmojiId.description: Custom emoji document ID (stringified long) for profile background pattern (Premium). Omit to remove.

tools.name: telegram-set-birthday
tools.description: Set your birthday in your Telegram profile. Year is optional (omit to hide age). Pass clear=true to remove birthday. Requires day and month unless clearing.

clear.description: Pass true to remove birthday from profile

tools.name: telegram-set-personal-channel
tools.description: Set the channel displayed on your profile as 'Personal Channel'. Pass clear=true to remove. Pass channelId or @username of a channel you own or are subscribed to.

channelId.description: Channel ID or @username to feature on profile

clear.description: Pass true to remove personal channel from profile

tools.name: telegram-set-profile-photo
tools.description: Upload and set a new profile photo from a local file. Supports JPEG/PNG for static avatar or MP4 for animated avatar (square, up to 10s). Optionally set as fallback photo shown to users who cannot see your main photo.

filePath.description: Absolute local filesystem path to photo (JPEG/PNG) or video (MP4, square) to upload as avatar. URLs are rejected.

isVideo.description: true if file is an MP4 animated avatar; false for static photo

videoStartTs.description: For video avatar: timestamp in seconds to use as still preview frame

fallback.description: true = set as fallback photo (shown to users who cannot see your main photo due to privacy settings)

tools.name: telegram-delete-profile-photo
tools.description: Delete one or more profile photos by their photo IDs. Photo IDs are the ones telegram-get-profile-photo returns. Returns which IDs were deleted and which were not found.

photoIds.description: Array of photo IDs (stringified long) to delete from your profile photo history

tools.name: telegram-get-business-chat-links
tools.description: List Telegram Business chat links configured for the account. Each entry includes the t.me/... link, the prefilled message, optional title (admin-facing label), views count, and entityCount. Requires Telegram Business — returns empty list when none configured.

tools.name: telegram-create-business-chat-link
tools.description: Create a Telegram Business chat link (t.me/m/... deep-link that opens a chat with you pre-filled with a message). Returns JSON with link, slug, message, title, and views. Requires Telegram Business subscription.

message.description: Pre-filled message text shown to users who click the link

title.description: Admin-facing label (not visible to visitors, max 32 chars)

parseMode.description: Format message as Markdown or HTML

tools.name: telegram-edit-business-chat-link
tools.description: Edit an existing Telegram Business chat link by its slug (the trailing segment after t.me/m/). Returns JSON with updated fields. Requires Telegram Business subscription.

slug.description: Link slug — the last path segment of t.me/m/<slug>

parseMode.description: Format message as Markdown or HTML

tools.name: telegram-delete-business-chat-link
tools.description: Delete a Telegram Business chat link by its slug. Requires Telegram Business subscription.

tools.name: telegram-resolve-business-chat-link
tools.description: Resolve a Telegram Business chat link by slug to see whose chat it opens and the pre-filled message. Returns JSON with peerId, peerType, message, and entityCount.

tools.name: telegram-set-business-hours
tools.description: Set Telegram Business work hours — days and time ranges when your business is open. Requires Telegram Business subscription. Pass clear=true to disable the work hours display entirely.

timezone.description: IANA timezone ID (e.g. 'Europe/Moscow', 'America/New_York'). Required when setting schedule.

openNow.description: Manually override current open/closed status. Omit to derive from schedule.

schedule.description: Weekly schedule. Multiple ranges per day are allowed.

openTo.description: Closing time in 24h HH:MM. Use '24:00' for end of day.

clear.description: Pass true to remove business hours entirely

tools.name: telegram-set-business-location
tools.description: Set Telegram Business physical location (address + optional geo coordinates). Requires Telegram Business subscription. Pass clear=true to remove.

clear.description: Pass true to remove business location

tools.name: telegram-set-business-greeting
tools.description: Set Telegram Business greeting message — auto-reply sent to new conversations using a quick reply shortcut as template. Requires Telegram Business subscription. Pass clear=true to disable.

shortcutId.description: Quick reply shortcut ID (from telegram-get-quick-replies) used as the greeting template

audience.description: Who receives the greeting: all_new (new contacts+non-contacts), contacts_only, non_contacts, existing_only

excludeUsers.description: Usernames/IDs to exclude — overrides audience. Cannot be combined with includeUsers.

noActivityDays.description: Send greeting if user has been inactive for N days

clear.description: Pass true to disable greeting message

tools.name: telegram-set-business-away
tools.description: Set Telegram Business away message — auto-reply when you are offline or outside work hours. Uses a quick reply shortcut as template. Requires Telegram Business subscription. Pass clear=true to disable.

shortcutId.description: Quick reply shortcut ID used as the away message template

schedule.description: When to send: always (any time offline), outside_hours (based on business hours), custom (time range)

customFrom.description: For schedule=custom: Unix timestamp range start

customTo.description: For schedule=custom: Unix timestamp range end

offlineOnly.description: Send only when you appear offline (true) or regardless of online status (false)

clear.description: Pass true to disable away message

tools.name: telegram-set-business-intro
tools.description: Set Telegram Business intro card — title and description shown to new users opening your chat, with an optional sticker. Requires Telegram Business subscription. Pass clear=true to remove.

stickerId.description: Sticker document ID (stringified long) — optional illustrative sticker. Requires stickerAccessHash and stickerFileReference.

stickerAccessHash.description: Access hash of the sticker document (required with stickerId)

clear.description: Pass true to remove the intro card

tools.name: telegram-create-folder
tools.description: Create a new Telegram chat folder (filter). Returns the new folder ID. Pass type flags to auto-include entire categories, or list specific chats in includePeers. Emoticon must be a single emoji character.

emoticon.description: Single emoji icon for the folder

pinnedPeers.description: Chats to pin at top of this folder (max 5)

tools.name: telegram-edit-folder
tools.description: Edit an existing Telegram chat folder by its ID (from telegram-get-chat-folders). Only pass fields you want to change — omitted fields keep their current values.

id.description: Folder ID (≥ 2; 0 = All Chats, 1 = Archive are system folders)

tools.name: telegram-delete-folder
tools.description: Delete a Telegram chat folder by its ID. Chats inside the folder are not deleted — they remain in All Chats. System folders (0 = All Chats, 1 = Archive) cannot be deleted.

tools.name: telegram-reorder-folders
tools.description: Reorder Telegram chat folders by specifying a new order of folder IDs. All existing custom folder IDs must be included.

order.description: Ordered list of folder IDs (≥ 2). Obtain IDs from telegram-get-chat-folders

tools.name: telegram-get-suggested-folders
tools.description: Get Telegram's suggested chat folders based on your chat list (e.g. 'Unread', 'Personal', 'Work'). Returns folder templates only; nothing is created.

tools.name: telegram-toggle-folder-tags
tools.description: Enable or disable folder tags (colored labels that appear on messages in chat lists when the message belongs to a tagged folder). Requires Telegram Premium.

enabled.description: true to enable folder tags, false to disable

tools.name: telegram-get-global-privacy-settings
tools.description: Get your account-level global privacy settings: whether new non-contacts are auto-archived/muted, whether archived chats are kept unmuted, whether read receipts are hidden, and whether non-contacts must have Premium to message you.

tools.name: telegram-set-global-privacy-settings
tools.description: Update account-level global privacy settings. Only pass the fields you want to change — omitted fields keep their current values. hideReadMarks and newNoncontactPeersRequirePremium require Telegram Premium.

archiveAndMuteNewNoncontactPeers.description: Auto-archive and mute messages from unknown users

keepArchivedUnmuted.description: Keep archived chats unmuted when archiving

keepArchivedFolders.description: Keep archived chats in their folders

hideReadMarks.description: Hide read receipts — others cannot see when you read their messages (Premium)

newNoncontactPeersRequirePremium.description: Only allow users with Telegram Premium to message you if they are not in your contacts (Premium)

tools.name: telegram-get-sticker-set
tools.description: Get all stickers from a sticker set by its short name. Returns each sticker with index and emoji. The index identifies the sticker in telegram-send-sticker.

shortName.description: Short name of the sticker set (e.g. 'AnimatedEmojis', 'HotCherry'). Find names via telegram-search-sticker-sets or from t.me/addstickers/<shortName> links

tools.name: telegram-search-sticker-sets
tools.description: Search for sticker sets by name or keyword. Returns the short names of matching sticker packs.

tools.name: telegram-get-installed-stickers
tools.description: List all sticker sets installed by the user. Returns pack titles and short names.

tools.name: telegram-send-sticker
tools.description: Send a sticker from a sticker set to a chat. The sticker is identified by the set's short name and its index in that set, as listed by telegram-get-sticker-set.

stickerSet.description: Short name of the sticker set (e.g. 'HotCherry')

index.description: Index of the sticker in the set (0-based, get from telegram-get-sticker-set)

tools.name: telegram-get-recent-stickers
tools.description: Get recently used stickers. Returns each sticker with its list index and associated emoji

tools.name: telegram-get-all-stories
tools.description: Fetch active stories from contacts/channels the user follows. Pagination via 'next' + 'state' — pass the returned state back on the next call with next:true to load more. Use hidden:true to read stories from muted/archived peers. Returns compact story metadata (id, date, expireDate, caption, mediaType, counters) without raw media blobs.

next.description: Load the next page (use with state from a prior response)

hidden.description: Fetch stories from hidden/archived peers instead of the main feed

state.description: Pagination state token returned by a previous call

tools.name: telegram-get-peer-stories
tools.description: Fetch currently active stories posted by a specific peer (user/channel). Returns compact story metadata (id, date, expireDate, caption, mediaType, counters) with media type className only — no raw media blobs. The media itself is not included; telegram-download-media returns it by story id.

chat.description: Peer to fetch stories from — user/channel id, @username, phone, or display name fragment

tools.name: telegram-get-stories-by-id
tools.description: Fetch specific stories from a peer by their numeric IDs. Useful for retrieving archived/pinned stories outside the active feed. Returns compact story metadata and optional pinnedToTop list. Pass up to ~100 ids per request.

chat.description: Peer to fetch stories from — user/channel id, @username, phone, or display name fragment

ids.description: Story IDs to fetch (1–100 per request)

tools.name: telegram-get-story-views
tools.description: List viewers of one of YOUR stories (stories.GetStoryViewsList). Returns per-viewer entries (user id, view date, their reaction emoji if any), plus totals (viewsCount, forwardsCount, reactionsCount) and nextOffset for pagination. Pass your own user id (numeric) or @username as the peer — this only works for stories you posted. Some accounts (non-Premium, old stories) may not get a full viewer list — a Premium hint is surfaced on typical errors.

chat.description: Peer owning the story — usually 'me' or your own user id/@username

storyId.description: Story ID to fetch viewers for

offset.description: Pagination offset from a previous response's nextOffset

tools.name: telegram-send-story
tools.description: Publish a new story (photo or video) to your profile or a channel you manage. Privacy: everyone/contacts/close_friends/selected (allowUserIds required for 'selected'). MediaAreas not supported in this version.

chatId.description: Peer to post the story to — 'me', @username, or numeric ID

filePath.description: Absolute path to the photo or video file to upload

parseMode.description: Caption parse mode: md or html

allowUserIds.description: Required when privacy='selected': numeric user IDs allowed to see the story

disallowUserIds.description: User IDs explicitly blocked from seeing the story (ignored for privacy='selected')

pinned.description: Keep the story in the profile highlights after expiry

noforwards.description: Prevent others from forwarding or saving the story

tools.name: telegram-edit-story
tools.description: Edit an existing story: replace media, update caption ('' clears it), or change privacy rules.

storyId.description: ID of the story to edit

type.description: Override auto-detected media type for new file

tools.name: telegram-delete-stories
tools.description: Delete one or more of your own stories. This action is irreversible and requires confirm:true.

ids.description: Story IDs to delete (1–100 per request)

confirm.description: Pass true to confirm irreversible deletion

tools.name: telegram-react-to-story
tools.description: React to a story with an emoji, or remove the current reaction by passing ''.

emoji.description: Reaction emoji. Empty string '' removes the reaction.

addToRecent.description: Add emoji to your recently used reactions

tools.name: telegram-export-story-link
tools.description: Get a shareable t.me/… URL for a public story.

storyId.description: Story ID to get the link for

tools.name: telegram-read-stories
tools.description: Mark stories as seen up to a given story ID (maxId, inclusive).

chatId.description: Peer whose stories to mark as seen

maxId.description: Stories up to and including this ID will be marked seen

tools.name: telegram-toggle-story-pinned
tools.description: Pin or unpin stories in your profile highlights (Telegram allows up to 3 pinned stories).

ids.description: Story IDs to pin or unpin

pinned.description: true to pin, false to unpin

tools.name: telegram-toggle-story-pinned-to-top
tools.description: Pin stories to the very top of your pinned row. Pass an empty array [] to clear all top-pinned stories.

ids.description: Story IDs to pin to the top row; pass [] to clear

tools.name: telegram-activate-stealth-mode
tools.description: Hide your story views retroactively (past=true) and/or for the next 25 minutes (future=true). Requires Telegram Premium — non-Premium accounts receive PREMIUM_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED.

past.description: Remove your views from stories you already watched

future.description: Hide your views for the next 25 minutes

tools.name: telegram-get-stories-archive
tools.description: Fetch auto-archived (expired) stories from a peer's archive. Paginate via offsetId (pass last story id from previous page).

offsetId.description: Pagination offset: pass last story ID from previous page (0 to start)

tools.name: telegram-report-story
tools.description: Report a story via the multi-step option flow. First call with option:'' starts the flow; subsequent calls pass the base64 option bytes from the previous response.

option.description: Base64-encoded option bytes from a prior report step, or empty string to start the flow

message.description: Optional message to accompany the report

tools.name: telegram-get-my-boosts
tools.description: List the user's premium boost slots (premium.GetMyBoosts). Each entry includes slot index, the peer it currently boosts (if any), the date the boost was applied, expiration timestamp, and cooldownUntilDate (when a slot can be reassigned). Premium users have multiple slots; non-Premium users typically have a single slot. Read-only.

tools.name: telegram-get-boosts-status
tools.description: Fetch the boost status of a channel/supergroup (premium.GetBoostsStatus). Returns current boost level, total boosts, progress to next level (currentLevelBoosts/nextLevelBoosts), giftBoosts, premiumAudience ratio, public boostUrl, and whether the current user is boosting (myBoost + myBoostSlots). Also includes any prepaidGiveaways attached to the chat. Read-only.

chat.description: Channel or supergroup to query — id, @username, or display name fragment

tools.name: telegram-get-boosts-list
tools.description: List the boosts applied to a channel/supergroup (premium.GetBoostsList). Returns paginated boost entries with id, userId (or undefined for anonymous gift boosts), date, expires, flags (gift, giveaway, unclaimed), optional giveawayMsgId, usedGiftSlug, multiplier, and stars. Requires channel admin permissions. Supports pagination via nextOffset and an optional gifts filter to show only gift boosts. Read-only.

chat.description: Channel or supergroup to query — id, @username, or display name fragment

gifts.description: If true, return only gift boosts

offset.description: Pagination cursor returned as nextOffset from the previous call

limit.description: Max boosts to return per page (default 50, max 100)

tools.name: telegram-get-group-call
tools.description: Fetch metadata + an optional initial slice of participants for the active group call (voice/video chat) attached to a chat (phone.GetGroupCall). Returns call info (id, accessHash, participantsCount, title, scheduleDate, recordStartDate, streamDcId, flags) plus a participant slice (peer, date, muted/left/self flags, source, volume, video/presentation indicators) and participantsNextOffset. Pass limit:0 (default) for metadata only. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_GROUP_CALLS=1. Read-only.

chat.description: Group/supergroup/channel that currently has an active group call — id, @username, or display name fragment

limit.description: Max participants to include (default 0 — metadata only; paginated lists are in telegram-get-group-call-participants)

tools.name: telegram-get-group-call-participants
tools.description: List participants of the active group call (voice/video chat) attached to a chat with pagination (phone.GetGroupParticipants). Looks up the chat's current InputGroupCall automatically, then returns {count, participants[], nextOffset?, version}. Each participant includes peer, date, source, volume, muted/self/left/videoJoined flags, raise-hand rating, about text, and hasVideo/hasPresentation indicators. Pass offset from a prior call's nextOffset to paginate; pass ids (user/channel peers) or sources to filter to specific participants. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_GROUP_CALLS=1. Read-only.

chat.description: Group/supergroup/channel that currently has an active group call — id, @username, or display name fragment

ids.description: Optional list of participant peer ids/@usernames to filter (max 100)

sources.description: Optional list of numeric source ids (audio SSRC) to filter participants

offset.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextOffset; omit for the first page

limit.description: Max participants to return in this page (default 100)

tools.name: telegram-get-stars-status
tools.description: Fetch the current Telegram Stars balance and recent activity for a peer (payments.GetStarsStatus). Pass 'me' / '@me' (or the user's own id) to inspect your own wallet, or a bot/channel peer you own/administrate. Returns {balance:{amount,nanos}, subscriptions?[], subscriptionsNextOffset?, subscriptionsMissingBalance?, history?[], nextOffset?}. Each transaction has id, stars, date, peer (kind: appStore|playMarket|premiumBot|fragment|ads|api|peer|unsupported), and flags (refund/pending/failed/gift/reaction). Use telegram-get-stars-transactions for full paginated history. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_STARS=1. Read-only.

peer.description: Peer whose Stars wallet to inspect — 'me'/'@me' or user id for self, or @username/id for a bot/channel you control

tools.name: telegram-get-stars-transactions
tools.description: Fetch a paginated Telegram Stars transaction history for a peer (payments.GetStarsTransactions). Pass 'me'/'@me' (or your own user id) for your wallet, or a bot/channel peer you own/administrate. Filters: inbound (credits only), outbound (debits only), ascending (chronological; default descending), subscriptionId (scope to a single subscription). Paginate with offset (cursor string from a prior response's nextOffset) and limit (default 50). Returns {balance, history[], nextOffset?, subscriptions?[], ...} — same shape as telegram-get-stars-status but focused on transactions. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_STARS=1. Read-only.

peer.description: Peer whose Stars transactions to fetch — 'me'/'@me' or user id for self, or @username/id for a bot/channel you control

inbound.description: If true, return only inbound (credit) transactions

outbound.description: If true, return only outbound (debit) transactions

ascending.description: If true, return transactions in chronological (oldest first) order; default: newest first

subscriptionId.description: If set, filter transactions to a single subscription id

offset.description: Pagination cursor — pass the nextOffset from a previous response; empty/undefined for first page

tools.name: telegram-get-available-star-gifts
tools.description: List all available Telegram Star Gifts that can be sent to other users. Returns gift ID, cost in Stars, conversion value, availability (for limited gifts), and upgrade cost. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_STARS=1. Read-only.

tools.name: telegram-get-saved-star-gifts
tools.description: List Star Gifts received by a user or chat. Pass 'me' for your own gifts. Supports pagination via offset/nextOffset and filtering flags. Returns gift ID, kind (regular/unique), stars cost, from-peer, date, and upgrade eligibility. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_STARS=1. Read-only.

chatId.description: User or chat to fetch received gifts for — 'me' for self

offset.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response's nextOffset

excludeUnsaved.description: Skip gifts the recipient chose to hide

excludeSaved.description: Skip gifts the recipient chose to show

sortByValue.description: Sort by Star value descending instead of date

tools.name: telegram-save-star-gift
tools.description: Show or hide a received Star Gift on your profile. Pass msgId for a gift received as a personal message (DM), or chatId + savedId for a gift in a chat/channel. Set unsave=true to hide the gift (remove from profile display). Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_STARS=1.

msgId.description: Message ID of the gift (from your DMs) — use this for personal gifts

chatId.description: Chat/channel ID where the gift was received (required with savedId for chat gifts)

savedId.description: Saved gift ID (from get-saved-star-gifts) — required with chatId for chat gifts

unsave.description: true = hide the gift from profile; false/omit = show it

tools.name: telegram-convert-star-gift
tools.description: Convert a received Star Gift into Stars (non-reversible). The gift is removed from your profile and its conversion value is added to your Stars balance. Pass msgId for personal gifts or chatId + savedId for chat gifts. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_STARS=1.

msgId.description: Message ID of the gift (from your DMs) — for personal gifts

chatId.description: Chat/channel ID (for chat gifts, required with savedId)

savedId.description: Saved gift ID — for chat gifts, required with chatId

tools.name: telegram-get-stars-topup-options
tools.description: List available Telegram Stars top-up tiers (from payments.GetStarsTopupOptions). Returns each option with star count, currency, price amount (in smallest currency units), and whether it is an extended/premium tier. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_STARS=1. Read-only.

tools.name: telegram-get-stars-subscriptions
tools.description: List active Telegram Stars subscriptions for a peer (payments.GetStarsSubscriptions). Pass 'me' for your own account or a bot/channel you own. Returns subscription ID, peer, renewal date, period, price in Stars, and canceled status. Paginate with offset. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_STARS=1. Read-only.

chatId.description: Peer to query — 'me' for your own subscriptions, or a bot/channel you own

offset.description: Pagination cursor from a prior nextOffset

missingBalance.description: If true, return only subscriptions with missing balance

tools.name: telegram-change-stars-subscription
tools.description: Cancel or restore a Telegram Stars subscription (payments.ChangeStarsSubscription). Pass canceled=true to cancel an active subscription before its next renewal, or false to restore a previously canceled one. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_STARS=1.

chatId.description: The peer the subscription belongs to — 'me' for your own subscriptions or a bot/channel you own

canceled.description: true = cancel the subscription; false = restore a canceled subscription

tools.name: telegram-get-quick-replies
tools.description: Fetch the list of quick-reply shortcuts configured for the user account (messages.GetQuickReplies). Each entry has {shortcutId, shortcut, topMessage, count} ; telegram-get-quick-reply-messages takes the shortcutId and shows the stored messages. Optional `hash` implements Telegram's hash-based diff: pass the last-known aggregate hash as a decimal string and the server may respond with {notModified:true} if nothing changed. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_QUICK_REPLIES=1. Read-only.

hash.description: Aggregate hash from a previous response (decimal string); omit for a fresh fetch

tools.name: telegram-get-quick-reply-messages
tools.description: Fetch messages stored under a quick-reply shortcut (messages.GetQuickReplyMessages). `shortcutId` comes from telegram-get-quick-replies. Optional `ids` narrows to specific message ids within the shortcut. Optional `hash` implements Telegram's hash-based diff: pass the last-known aggregate hash as a decimal string — the server may respond with {notModified:true, count} if nothing changed. Returns compact {count, messages[{id, date, text, isService, fromId?, replyToMsgId?}]}. Opt-in: register only when MCP_TELEGRAM_ENABLE_QUICK_REPLIES=1. Read-only.

ids.description: Optional list of message ids to fetch within the shortcut

hash.description: Aggregate hash from a previous response (decimal string); omit for a fresh fetch

tools.name: telegram-get-saved-music
tools.description: List the songs pinned to a user's profile (users.GetSavedMusic) — the tracks behind the music row on a Telegram profile. Returns count plus tracks with title, performer, duration, fileName, mimeType and size; element 0 is the track shown on the profile. Defaults to your own profile. Supports pagination via offset/limit and returns nextOffset when more remain. Read-only.

user.description: User to query — id, @username, or display name fragment. Defaults to yourself

limit.description: Max tracks to return per page (default 50, max 100)
